name: astra
author: xLonely
description:
To play on Arch:

1. Install Astra Strike in Nexus. Open a terminal and run:

sudo pacman -S --needed rust

2. Build the game engine. In a terminal, run:

~/.local/share/caelestia/plugins/xlonely-astra/engine/build.sh

3. In Nexus → Plugins, enable Astra Strike, then use its rocket quick toggle. The engine is built inside the plugin; no separate PATH setup is needed.
